messages.author: 7783e331a19d823a
messages.subject: Multi-season occupancy plotting query - colext()
parts:
Dear All,

I am running some multi-season occupancy models in unmarked (colext()), and have some issues regarding plotting outputs that I would like some input on if possible.

I am visualizing the relationship between covariates and occupancy/colonization/extinction parameters from a model by plotting predicted probabilities of these covariates from model output against ‘fake’ data.

Data breakdown:
unmarkedFrame Object

 105 sites
Maximum number of observations per site: 9
Mean number of observations per site: 6.52
Number of primary survey periods: 3
Number of secondary survey periods: 3
Sites with at least one detection: 71

 Tabulation of y observations:

   0    1 <NA>
  337  348  260

 Site-level covariates:
       silt           embed       substrate   
 Min.   :1.000   Min.   :1.0   Min.   : 0.00 
 1st Qu.:1.000   1st Qu.:1.0   1st Qu.:50.00 
 Median :2.000   Median :1.0   Median :70.00 
 Mean   :2.257   Mean   :1.8   Mean   :61.24 
 3rd Qu.:3.000   3rd Qu.:3.0   3rd Qu.:80.00 
 Max.   :5.000   Max.   :4.0   Max.   :80.00 

 Observation-level covariates:
 v_temp_m   
Min.   : 0.00 
1st Qu.:14.67 
Median :16.28 
Mean   :16.07 
3rd Qu.:17.31 
Max.   :24.21 
NA's   :260   

 Yearly-site-level covariates:
     silt_y         embed_y       
Min.   :1.000   Min.   :1.000  
 1st Qu.:2.000   1st Qu.:1.000  
 Median :2.000   Median :1.000  
 Mean   :2.403   Mean   :1.851  
 3rd Qu.:3.000   3rd Qu.:3.000     
 Max.   :5.000   Max.   :4.000    

If I run a model with ONLY ONE initial occupancy covariate, I can visualize predicted probability of that covariate as follows:

M1 <-colext(psiformula= ~scale(embed), gammaformula = ~1, epsilonformula = ~ 1, pformula = ~ 1, data = umf, method="BFGS")

pred <- data.frame(embed = seq(1,4, length.out = 105)) # create a predictor data frame
pred.p <- predict(p.test, type='psi', newdata=pred) #try newdata = data,frame(embed=pred)
print(predictions<-cbind(pred.p, pred))

plot(1, xlim=c(1,4), ylim=c(0,1), type="n", axes=T, xlab="Embeddedness", pch=20, ylab=expression(paste(psi)), cex=1.3, family="calibri", cex.lab=1.25, cex.main=1.75, xaxt = 'n')
axis(side = 1, at = seq(from = 1, to = 4, by = 1, labelts = T))

lines(predictions$embed, predictions$Predicted, col="black", lwd=2)
lines(predictions$embed, predictions$lower, lty=2, col="black")
lines(predictions$embed, predictions$upper, lty=2, col="black")


However, when I add a second initial occupancy covariate, and try to plot the same covariate as above, my predicted values and subsequent plot look particularly strange:

M2 <-colext(psiformula= ~scale(embed) + scale (silt), gammaformula = ~1, epsilonformula = ~ 1, pformula = ~ 1, data = umf, method="BFGS")

pred <- data.frame(embed = seq(1,4, length.out = 105)) # create a predictor data frame
pred.p <- predict(p.test, type='psi', newdata=pred) #try newdata = data,frame(embed=pred)
print(predictions<-cbind(pred.p, pred))

plot(1, xlim=c(1,4), ylim=c(0,1), type="n", axes=T, xlab="Embeddedness", pch=20, ylab=expression(paste(psi)), cex=1.3, family="calibri", cex.lab=1.25, cex.main=1.75, xaxt = 'n')
axis(side = 1, at = seq(from = 1, to = 4, by = 1, labelts = T))

lines(predictions$embed, predictions$Predicted, col="black", lwd=2)
lines(predictions$embed, predictions$lower, lty=2, col="black")
lines(predictions$embed, predictions$upper, lty=2, col="black")


am The graph reflects the general pattern of the relationship, but is obviously incorrect.

This issue is also evident when I try to plot models with extinction and colonization parameters.

Any assistant would be appreciated!

Thanks,

Josh

messages.author: 4f80e1927b0757cb
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Multi-season occupancy plotting query - colext()
parts:
One issue I see is that you need to include a value for the 2nd covariate (silt) in your newdata. Typically you would use the mean or median values for the non-focal covariates.

Ken
